packageRules.description: disable update of flux images by kubernetes manager (as they are solely managed by flux manager)

disable minio updates due to OSS unfriendly practices until a suitable replacement is found (all update types, deliberately unenumerated: enumerating types let replacement/rollback/bump fall through to override-calver with automerge on)
do not update pihole until blocky trial is done

description: disable kubernetes-manager updates of the vendored flux toolkit manifest. The flux manager
legitimately updates fluxcd/flux2 via this file, so this rule must stay scoped to
matchManagers: [kubernetes] -- an unscoped enabled:false here would stop flux2 upgrades of
clusterops-core entirely. This records the intent behind the kubernetes.ignorePaths entry in
renovate.json and keeps the exclusion effective if that override is ever removed. Note: that
manager-level ignorePaths override (non-mergeable) is also the only reason the kubernetes
manager scans ci/test/** at all (:ignoreModulesAndTests ignores **/test/**); restoring the
preset uniformly would stop Renovate updating ci/test/** image pins (fixture drift) -- a
maintainer decision, deliberately not made here.
